subject: Microsoft 365 recovers 📧, Claude joins meetings 🤝, AWS syncs secrets 🔑
notes: No funding rounds, acquisitions, IPOs or funds in this issue. Sponsor block (Verkada) ignored.

stories.headline: Microsoft says service is restored for all customers after an outage of Exchange Online, Teams and Copilot from Thursday into Saturday
stories.quote:
Microsoft says it restored service to all customers after an outage
disrupted Exchange Online, Teams, Copilot, and other connected
services from Thursday into Saturday.

facts.text: Servers failing automated health checks contributed; first recovery attempts did not give the expected relief.
facts.quote:
Servers failing automated health
checks contributed to the disruption, and initial recovery attempts
failed to provide the expected relief.

facts.text: A separate analysis item says the outage shows the risk of consolidating email, collaboration and productivity tools under one provider.
facts.quote:
Microsoft's outage highlights how consolidating email, collaboration,
and productivity tools under one provider can amplify disruption.

stories.headline: Microsoft to raise commercial cloud prices by 15.7% in India and 10% in New Zealand from 1 January 2027
stories.quote:
Microsoft will increase commercial cloud prices by 15.7% in India and
10% in New Zealand starting January 1, 2027, citing currency
adjustments.

facts.text: The increases take effect on 1 January 2027; Microsoft cites currency adjustments.
facts.quote:
Microsoft will increase commercial cloud prices by 15.7% in India and
10% in New Zealand starting January 1, 2027, citing currency
adjustments.

facts.text: Prices fall in China, Australia and Norway; some on-premises products in India rise by up to 20%.
facts.quote:
Prices will fall in China, Australia, and Norway, while
some on-premises products in India face increases of up to 20%.

stories.headline: Anthropic rolls out Claude Meetings in beta for Team and Enterprise customers; Claude can join Google Meet calls
stories.quote:
Anthropic is rolling out Claude Meetings in beta for Team and
Enterprise customers, letting Claude join Google Meet calls to answer
questions, draft documents, and capture action items.

facts.text: Integrations with Granola, Gong, Attention, Fireflies.ai, Otter and Plaud are planned.
facts.quote:
Upcoming
integrations with Granola, Gong, Attention, Fireflies.ai, Otter, and
Plaud will let teams send meeting transcripts to their existing tools.

stories.headline: LMSYS launches the SGLang Consortium for its open-source AI inference engine; Nvidia, AMD, Intel, Google and Meta are founding members
stories.quote:
LMSYS launched the SGLang Consortium to coordinate engineering work
on its open-source AI inference engine, with founding members
including Nvidia, AMD, Intel, Google, and Meta.

facts.text: Members contribute feedback, testing and development work; SGLang's maintainers keep control of technical decisions.
facts.quote:
Members will
contribute deployment feedback, testing resources, and development
work, while SGLang's maintainers retain control over technical
decisions.

stories.headline: AWS Secrets Manager adds cross-account replication of secrets
stories.quote:
AWS Secrets Manager now supports cross-account replication, allowing
teams to maintain synchronized copies of primary secrets across AWS
accounts for backup, disaster recovery, and cross-account access.

stories.headline: GitHub will retire six Copilot models on 14 December
stories.quote: GitHub will retire six selected Copilot models on December 14.

facts.text: Retirement date for the six Copilot models.
facts.quote: GitHub will retire six selected Copilot models on December 14.
